title: docs: add focused design questioning guidance
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds design questions before implementation when answers could change user outcomes, scope, UX, constraints, or architecture.
- Keeps interviews focused: investigate facts independently, recommend tradeoffs, revise the design after answers, and stop once consequential choices are settled.
- Preserves existing safety approvals and avoids repeating answered questions or requesting permission already given; CLAUDE.md already imports AGENTS.md.
- Validation: reviewed the seven-line, AGENTS.md-only diff; `git diff --check` passed. Biome processed no files because Markdown was ignored; no runtime code changed.

gist.headline: Questions Before Concrete
gist.blurb: The garden shed gained a small sign: ask the design questions that actually change the build, then stop digging once the path is clear.
gist.summary: Added seven lines to AGENTS.md directing implementation work to ask focused design questions only when answers could change user outcomes, scope, UX, constraints, or architecture.
gist.impact: Contributors get a clearer decision-making loop: independently verify facts, recommend tradeoffs, revise the design after consequential answers, and avoid re-asking settled questions or approvals.
gist.visual_concept: Polli wears tiny architect glasses beside a cozy garden workbench, sorting a few meaningful design-question cards into a plan while a code-plant grows from the finalized blueprint. A small sign shows that only consequential questions need watering.
